summary: LiqTech International filed an 8-K regarding a Debt Cancellation Agreement with Note Holders (affiliates of Bleichroeder L.P., 21 April Fund). The Company will cancel $3.0M of senior promissory notes in exchange for common stock at the public offering price per share from a concurrent S-1 offering, and pay $3.0M plus accrued interest in cash, retiring the notes. No board recommendation or advisors named. The transaction is tied to an underwritten public offering and involves unregistered shares under Section 4(a)(2). Watch for S-1 pricing and closing mechanics; no special-situation event apart from a debt-to-equity conversion.
